sentences.text: Smt. Swati Aseem Geroge - Deputy Advocate General for the  ORDER
This is the first bail application under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhinta filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

T he applicant has been arrested on 30.05.2024 by Police Station - Chhagaon Makhan, District Khandwa (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.235 of 2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) and 506 of the IPC.
2. The allegation against the applicant is that on a false pretext of marriage applicant has committed the aforesaid offence.
3. It is submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case and he has not committed any offence in any manner.
It is submitted that the investigation is complete and the charge-sheet has been filed on 25.06.2024.
The applicant is the first offender and is in custody since 30.05.2024.
There is no further requirement of custodial interrogation of the present applicant in the matter.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the bail application.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail.
2 MCRC-29036-2024 4 . Per contra, learned counsel appearing for the State has vehemently opposed the application.
However, State counsel could not dispute the fact that the applicant is the first offender, as per the case diary records.
5. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed subject to verification of the fact that the applicant is the first offender.
He is directed to be released on bail on furnishing surety bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

It is also directed Deepak vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167593941/
1 that the applicant shall comply with the conditions as enumerated under Section 437(3) of CrPC.
6.
